statement: A holding-directory age bound enforced in the product repository's own test suite turns a silent upstream courier into a repository-wide merge freeze. Alfred's scheduled courier opened no delivery PR after 2026-10-07. Nothing alarmed: its backlog watcher reads only the PRs the courier opens. The first signal was cejel's maeve-lesson-delivery test failing on main and on an unrelated release PR (#498) once the oldest seed reached 8 days, with 33 seeds undelivered. Rule: when an age bound sits downstream of a scheduled courier, also alarm on the courier's own last successful run. On a freeze, deliver with the unchanged harvest script and retire by deletion. Never by widening the bound or re-dating a seed.
